title: MudRNG
tagline: MUD-RNG is a library package to get a random number in a MUD project.
description:
MUD-RNG is a Random Number Generator
MUD-RNG is a library package built for Autonomous hackathon to get a random number in a MUD project.
Very useful for applications, specially for gaming , NFT and DeFi projects building on MUD
Install MUD-RNG in one simple command and integrate with one line of code
how_its_made:
Built using Solidity for contract/library 
It is a solidity contract wrapped in a npm package for quick integration into your project.
MUD-RNG is a library package built for Autonomous hackathon to get a random number in a MUD project.
Very useful for applications, specially for gaming , NFT and DeFi projects building on MUD
Install MUD-RNG in one simple command and integrate with one line of code
